_comment: Cold runs of every honest reference through check.py, in CPU SECONDS: `stages.solution.cpu_seconds` (the compile of the reference's Solution.lean, nothing else), with the wall clock of the same run (`stages.solution.seconds`) beside it. The input of score/time_limits.py, which holds every task to the one limit of 300 CPU s (decided 2026-11-02, the value 2026-11-06; it was 120 s of wall clock), names every reference above the 150 CPU s target, and fails when a measurement is not in CPU seconds or a reference task.json lists has none. T = the largest CPU run of the slowest reference of the task. Re-measured 2026-11-16, all three sweeps of every reference, after the move to Proglib 4fcda4c87 (the tactic library changed; the toolchain, v4.35.0, and the machine did not); the runs before are in this file's history. Re-measure after a change of the tactic library, the toolchain or the machine: put the new runs here and run `python3 score/time_limits.py --check`. Not hashed by the checker.

environment.date: 2026-11-16 (UTC): sweep 1 is the round's check of every reference at the tip (the final sweep for the references whose check reaches SvGolf/Cycle.lean, the round's last change a check reads; for the others the run at byte-identical inputs earlier that day), sweeps 2 and 3 followed it
environment.machine: a shared Linux build server, Intel Xeon Platinum 8488C, 96 hardware threads, 371 GB of memory: other users' jobs ran throughout, and up to four of these check.py processes ran at once (one Lean process each), fewer while the machine's Lean job budget was in use; which cores ran a process was not controlled
environment.build: COLD per run: a new check.py process and a fresh staging directory (--stage-dir, removed before each run) for every run; the project build (svGolf, tasks, LeanModels.Sv) was warm and current, not timed; the OS file cache was not purged
environment.threads: LEAN_NUM_THREADS=2, nice 19, each run in its own systemd scope with MemoryMax=8G and no swap; the CPU seconds count both threads
environment.lean_cache: svGolf and LeanModels.Sv .olean files built and current, the staged Submission/*.olean built from scratch inside each run; lean-toolchain leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0, Proglib 4fcda4c87
environment.postsynth_mode: none: --no-score --ppa off (no score, no post-synthesis; neither enters the solution stage)
environment.reference_commit: the references of this tree (none changed between the sweeps and the publication)
environment.measured_with: check.py tasks/<task> tasks/<task>/reference/<stem>.sv tasks/<task>/reference/<stem>.lean --no-score --ppa off --sandbox off --no-trusted-build --stage-dir <fresh> --json <out> (the sandbox is off on this machine; the trusted target was built beforehand)
